## Design

### 2026-10-19 – Today, I wasn't able to do much.

**0.25h**

Today, I wasn't able to do much.

I just familiarized myself with the project and made a new project file on Kicad and set up all the libraries. I really like how beginner friendly the guide is currently, making me kind of wish it was the first one we did.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xLV9v2yZsf8cQU2Q5GZ9YV3OSKXKe8Gz/6fda6ba431012fc040fbb0d80b0c72c0f6f15072d43ab879737aae969a4ae56a.png)

The guide mentioned 3D shapes for the parts so that they actually show up in 3D view of the PCB editor, which is pretty cool. In the starbie project, when I saw my 3D view, I was confused as to why their parts didn't show up like in the guide's, but I guess it was because they made custom 3D models and imported them into Kicad.

### 2026-10-21 – Today, I will assign footprints and start the PCB design.

**0.83h**

Today, I will assign footprints and start the PCB design.

Funnily, I struggled to assign the footprints as for some reason the bar wasn't showing up. After a bit of trying to figure out what went wrong, I saw that the bar somehow got pushed to the side/wasn't visible, so then I was able to see it and start to assign the footprints.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xLV9v2yZsf8cQU2Q5GZ9YV3OSKXKe8Gz/1df5893f4d2b323698cda631aafc77b01905f012c39d71e240b2f9779fb4f81d.png)

It took me a solid 5 minutes looking for the footprint editor, as I didn't see where it was. I finally found it in tools -->

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/xLV9v2yZsf8cQU2Q5GZ9YV3OSKXKe8Gz/c3a4b44349cf2bda340b2ea2b163807a265c8a6afa41db0bf9207befb35aa202.png)

### 2026-10-22 – Today, I'll come up with a theme and create art so that I can trace over it in the PCB footprint editor.

**1.17h**

Today, I'll come up with a theme and create art so that I can trace over it in the PCB footprint editor.

I struggled to come up with a good theme, so I just scrolled around until I saw this.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/xLV9v2yZsf8cQU2Q5GZ9YV3OSKXKe8Gz/b4de44cd5a2b2dd8f9b8cbeb891983edd5de027f1928fae6befa0747abe9b23c.png)

So I started making it, and somehow, it went better than I expected. I just need to clean it up.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/xLV9v2yZsf8cQU2Q5GZ9YV3OSKXKe8Gz/15ff411c246ecd16dfae2e819489e126ebbdeab5802dd7de5757ee926797a34f.png)

Wow the program was being so nice, when drawing, it let me know where the old drawing ended/started its points, which helped a lot. I think I'll break the drawing into pieces so that its more customizable.

-------

When redrawing, I made "new" wings by using the fillet tool, and I like it.
Maybe I can just have both butterfly wing types, no need for them to be the same. So I have nine keys, so 4 butterflies, 4 flowers, and maybe something as a centerpiece?
